reviews.snippet:
Dr Shoeb is truly a gift from Allah for us.

My mother was critical with kidney issues + BP/sugar. Dr Shoeb explained everything patiently, gave us clear guidance, and treated her with so much care and dignity. His knowledge and calm nature gave our whole family strength during a scary time.

May Allah bless him with more knowledge, health, and barakah. Hyderabad is lucky to have a nephrologist like him.

Highly recommend Dr Shoeb for any kidney/ureter/ dialysis cases. 5/5 stars.

Regard Mohammed Imran Bidar

reviews.snippet:
1. Medical Care & Safety
•	Experienced nephrologists (Dr Shoeb) and dialysis technicians (under highly experienced Mr Srisailam)
•	Proper infection control practices
•	Regular monitoring of vitals during dialysis
•	Emergency readiness
Highly skilled doctors and technicians who closely monitor patients throughout the dialysis session.

2. Hygiene & Cleanliness
•	Clean dialysis machines
•	Sanitized environment
•	Proper disposal of medical waste
The dialysis unit maintains excellent hygiene and strict sterilization protocols.

3. Staff Behavior
•	Friendly technicians
•	Quick response to patient needs
•	Respectful communication
The staff are extremely caring, attentive, and supportive during every session.

4. Equipment & Technology
•	Modern dialysis machines
•	Availability of HD / HDF dialysis
•	Well-maintained equipment

The center uses advanced dialysis technology and well-maintained machines.

5. Patient Comfort
•	Comfortable beds/chairs
•	Clean waiting area
•	Good scheduling system

Note: I would like to give a 5-star rating specifically to the dialysis unit. The doctors, nurses, and technicians provide excellent care and maintain high standards of hygiene, safety, and patient monitoring. The staff are attentive, professional, and ensure that patients are comfortable throughout their dialysis sessions.

This rating is based solely on the quality of care provided within the dialysis unit. My experience with the management team has been less satisfactory, and I hope there will be improvements in communication and patient interaction in the future.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to MR. SRISAILAM SIR, the Head of Dialysis Department.
Not only is he extremely professional and knowledgeable in his field, but he is also a truly kind and humble human being. During one of the most difficult phases of life, his emotional support, patience, and understanding made a huge difference for me and my family.
He treats every patient with respect, listens carefully, and always encourages with positive words. His supportive nature gives strength and hope to patients who are going through challenging times.
We are deeply thankful for his dedication, compassion, and continuous care. May he continue to serve and heal many more lives.

reviews.snippet:
I want to speak honestly for the sake of Allah so that people are not misled. Many positive comments online do not match the real situation. We stayed in the hospital for 10 days and saw everything ourselves.

Dr. Shoeb shows in videos that creatinine levels drop quickly, but the real reason behind it is not explained. They simply give dialysis to reduce CREATININE. This can be done in any other hospitals near your home in better price. There is no special or unique treatment that requires coming all the way to Hyderabad.

We went with hope, but we were disappointed. Many patients we met there were also unhappy. The only medicines (without diolesys) did not help them, and there was no improvement. People traveling from far away, it is a waste of time and money. They treat you very well for the first two days to gain your trust and charge you heavily. After taking the money, their attitude changes and the care drops completely

The staff are polite, but they are trained more like SALES PERSON in a showroom. They focus on charging patients or increasing sales, not helping patient. SAP is just a clinic, but they charge like a VIP hospitals. If someone is not financially strong, please avoid this place. There are many better hospitals in India that treat patients properly for a fair price.

As Muslims, we expect honesty. Using religion to gain trust and then overcharging patients is not acceptable in Islam. Many non-Muslim hospitals in India provide excellent treatment at much lower prices, and we respect their fairness. Being a Muslim comes with responsibility, please don’t use religion as a marketing tool.

We understand hospitals have expenses, but we have visited top hospitals across India, and none of them charge as much as SAP for normal treatments.
